---
name: Ticket
about: One ticket, one PR. The headings are the ones ticket-lint.py checks.
labels: needs-triage
---

## Parent

Spec #<n>, or the lane (Fixes, `Next`, Architecture) and why.

## What happens now

The current behaviour, as a user or caller sees it.

## What should happen

The desired behaviour. Name types, functions and behaviour rather than file paths. Name the foreseeable bad inputs and failures, each with what should happen.

## Done when

- [ ] A testable criterion. **Check:** how (the test, its level, or what to read).

## Needs

None, or what it waits for (an owner step, another ticket).

## Out of scope

What this ticket leaves to others.

<!-- An owner-only ticket (ready-for-human) also needs "## Why a human" and "## How to finish".
     Add "## Blocked by" with #N lines when it waits on another issue. -->
